Container.Name: ShadowPKG-Builder
Container.Overview: EXPERIMENTAL. Builds ShadowPKG "Build .pkg" jobs on the server itself, running a Windows repack kit that you supply under Wine. Build the image first: docker build -t shadowpkg-builder tools/container. Easiest: run install.sh from tools/container, which does all of this and leaves the network off. By hand, with Network left on bridge, from a console: docker exec -it ShadowPKG-Builder node /app/runner.js setup, or the steps one at a time: (1) docker exec -d ShadowPKG-Builder node /app/runner.js init, and follow /config/init.log until it says INIT COMPLETE; (2) docker exec -it ShadowPKG-Builder node /app/runner.js smoke; (3) docker exec -it ShadowPKG-Builder node /app/runner.js trust, which approves the kit's exact files. Then set Network to None and recreate: nothing after setup needs it. A restart kills a running build, so keep this container out of scheduled backup, auto-update and restart jobs. See the README.

Config.Name: Kit (read-only)
Config.Description: The folder holding your repack kit, already EXTRACTED: build-from-folder.ps1, scripts/ and toolchain/ directly inside it. Never put it in the image.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The same folder ShadowPKG's own Library points at, so job paths line up. The finished package is written here, next to the dump.

Config.Name: ShadowPKG config (read-only)
Config.Description: ShadowPKG's own config folder. The runner reads builds.json from it to find waiting jobs, so it needs no network access.

Config.Name: Runner config
Config.Description: Holds pins.json (the approved kit hashes) and init.log.

Config.Name: Wine prefix
Config.Description: The Wine environment (about 2 GB once .NET is in). Kept out of the image so recreating the container does not lose it.

Config.Name: Work folder
Config.Description: Scratch space for builds: a copy of the kit, the SDK's temp files, and the package before it is copied out. Put it on a fast disk with room for about the size of the biggest dump.

Config.Name: LIBRARIES
Config.Description: Leave empty. ShadowPKG lists its libraries in its config folder, and the builder uses every one whose folder is mounted here at the same container path as in ShadowPKG (add a Path for each extra library: container path /extra-libraries/Seed, host path the same folder). Only for a library mounted at a different path: id=path, comma separated, e.g. seed=/seed.

Config.Name: COPY_DUMP
Config.Description: Set to 1 to copy the dump to the Work folder before building. Worth trying if reading straight from the array is slow, because the SDK memory-maps the dump's files.
